text:
alana: Heads-up — we have the webinar + benchmark release next Wed. Need a concise social plan: X thread + LinkedIn post + follow-up DM sequence. Can someone own assets? :eyes:
miguel: I can own scheduling and copy. Need final 1) hero stat from the benchmark, 2) 2 hero screenshots (latency/cost chart + model config), 3) CTA URL for webinar sign-up.
jen: I can do the screenshots and a 1:1 vertical gif for stories. Can we get the exact chart export? PNG + source fig ok.
alana: Hero stat = “40% token-cost reduction at 95th pct latency vs baseline” — nat added this to the PR. CTA = https://redwood.com/webinar-mar-31 (utm to follow).
natalie: Copy guidance: keep X thread conversational + 1 technical nugget per card. For LinkedIn use the longer narrative (3 short paras) and add the benchmark table as a carousel.
sam: For inbound routing: seed priority to enterprise SDRs for accounts with >1k msgs/quarter. After webinar, send warm leads CSV to SalesOps. Can we add a quick lead-gen CTA in the thread (book a demo) and a separate link to watch recording?
miguel: Proposed cadence: 1) Thread teaser (Mon AM), 2) Main launch (Wed 10am PT), 3) Reminder (Wed 1pm PT), 4) Recording + follow-up + DM outreach (Thu). Anyone object?
jen: fine. I'll upload assets by Tue 5pm PT. Need brand color key and correct font — use Inter variable.
natalie: Copy drafts — quick A/B options:
- A: "We just cut inference token cost by 40% while keeping 95th-pct latency under 120ms. See how we did it → [link]"
- B: "Lower cost, same snappy latency. Our new benchmark shows 40% token savings at production p95. Webinar Wed. [link]"
miguel: I like A for X and B for LinkedIn. Also, CTA buttons: "Watch live" vs "See the benchmark" — which do we surface on X?
alana: Use "See the benchmark" on X thread; "Watch live" on the LinkedIn post.
sam: On the DM sequence: 1) immediate thank-you + recording link, 2) 48h follow-up asking about usage patterns + CTA to book, 3) 7d case-study offer if still engaged. Add tags in CRM: webinar=mar31, interest=benchmark.
miguel: tagging schedule in Sprout and Buffer. Will we use a shortened thread-style card order? Suggest: Hook (stat), quick methodology line, 2 chart cards, CTA.
jen: Uploading two chart PNGs now. Trigger: `uploader-bot upload /marketing/benchmark/charts`
uploader-bot: Uploaded: `latency_vs_cost.png`, `quant-config-compare.png` to /marketing/benchmark/ — public preview link: https://files.redwood.com/marketing/benchmark/preview
atalie: Small ask — can we test two opening lines on X (A/B) for first 30 minutes engagement? Miguel can we set that up?
miguel: Yep — I'll run A/B and route higher-engagement post to boosted timeline for 2 hrs. Need final copy by Tue 8pm PT.
alana: Great. Jen — confirm assets by Tue 5pm. Miguel — schedule + AB by Tue 8pm. Sam — prepare SDR seedlist export by Wed 9am PT. Natalie — finalize copy and webinar slide blurbs. I'll sync with Ops on tracking. :party_parrot:
jen: Confirmed.
uploader-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-delete temp previews in 7 days.
alan a: (typo) — ignore
alana: Thanks team — sending the brief to the thread and pinning this. Let's keep replies short in this thread for clarity. :rocket:
